description: The image displays a set of three pie charts, titled "easy," "medium," and "hard," with the text "Zero-Shot" centered below the middle chart, representing a comparison of four categories across these three difficulty levels. Each chart is divided into four slices corresponding to categories defined in a shared legend positioned to the right of the "hard" chart. The categories and their associated colors are N+K+ (teal), N−K+ (yellow), N−K− (light orange), and N+K− (dark orange). In the "easy" chart, the proportions are 55.4% for teal (N+K+), 38.3% for yellow (N−K+), 4.6% for light orange (N−K−), and 1.7% for dark orange (N+K−). The "medium" chart displays 58.8% for teal (N+K+), 35.4% for yellow (N−K+), 4.0% for light orange (N−K−), and 1.8% for dark orange (N+K−). The "hard" chart shows 18.1% for teal (N+K+), 37.3% for yellow (N−K+), 37.9% for light orange (N−K−), and 6.7% for dark orange (N+K−). All charts include exact percentage labels directly inside their respective slices. None of the slices are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset. Visually, in the "easy" and "medium" charts, the slices appear ordered by descending size in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, whereas the "hard" chart maintains the same clockwise categorical sequence but does not follow a descending size order.
